scheme_name: Jharkhand Sports Excellence Cash Award Scheme to Players
other_conditions: Athletes must represent Jharkhand in competitions recognized by national or international Olympic committees
Athletes must have secured a medal or participated in such competitions
Record‑setting athletes are eligible for additional cash incentives
For a single competition, the award is based on the highest achievement if multiple medals are won
benefits_summary: Cash awards ranging from ₹75,000 to ₹5 crore are provided for gold, silver and bronze medals in various national and international competitions.
